Undergraduate Programmes | College of Humanities, Arts and Social Sciences | NTU Singapore
The School of Art, Design and Media offers studio-based undergraduate degree programmes.
Bachelor of Fine Arts (BFA) in Design Art Specialisations: Interaction Design, Product Design, Visual Communication.
The School of Humanities offers degrees in Chinese, English, History, Linguistics and Multilingual Studies, and Philosophy.
Bachelor of Arts (Hons) Majors: Chinese, English, History, Linguistics and Multilingual Studies, Philosophy.
The School of Social Sciences offers degrees in Economics, Psychology, Public Policy and Global Affairs, and Sociology.
Bachelor of Social Sciences (Hons) Majors: Economics, Psychology, Public Policy and Global Affairs, Sociology.
